data.narrative:
Pale Blue is a Series A–stage space and aerospace company founded by Jun Asakawa and Yuichi Nakagawa. The firm has raised $7.5M in equity plus $27M in grants to date. Valuation triangulation draws on two applicable methodologies applied against a comp universe of 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs.

Stage-progression methodology applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $8M total-raised proxy, implying a $15M valuation. Peer-median analysis is anchored to three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Starcloud ($1.1B, Seed). The median of this peer set is $1.3B, with a range of $1.1B–$2.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; while the Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 27.4x median P/S across six public tickers, Pale Blue's revenue is not on file.

Triangulation across the two applicable methods yields a low bound of $13M, a median of $658M, and a high bound of $1.5B. The wide dispersion reflects the tension between early-stage funding history and late-stage peer valuations. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory (absent from available data) and whether private peer comparables—which span seed through Series B and vastly different technology maturity—appropriately anchor a nascent Series A company.
